report-transfer.scripts/assemble_report.py:
from pathlib import Path
import html
import json
evidence = json.loads(Path("evidence/cohorts.json").read_text())
template = Path("templates/report.html").read_text()
if Path("failure.json").exists() and json.loads(Path("failure.json").read_text()).get("simulate_assembly_failure"):
    raise RuntimeError("Synthetic assembly failure before output replacement")
output = template.replace("<!-- METRICS -->", html.escape(json.dumps(evidence, sort_keys=True)))
Path("report.html").write_text(output)

assert 'random-A' in text and 'enriched-B' in text
assert 'Unmatched samples' in text
